steps.instructions: Phase 1/3 REQUIREMENTS (requirements analyst): read the requirements the launch attached and list each one with its id, the behaviour it asks for and how it would be shown to hold. GROUND FIRST: query the code graph through the wicked-garden-search skill and the read-only estate shim, one call per lookup: "$WICKED_GARDEN_ROOT/scripts/wicked-garden" run scripts/_estate_client.py --readonly call '{"tool":"SearchEntity","arguments":{"name":"<symbol>"}}' (always --readonly); then open and read every file you cite, at the lines you cite. READ-ONLY: create, edit or delete no file in any repository, commit nothing, and run no command that writes there; your output is the report.

Phase 2/3 TRACE (search skill): for each requirement, find the code that implements it and the tests that check it (lineage and blast radius from the code graph, then the files); mark each requirement implemented, partial or missing, and list the code no requirement explains. GROUND FIRST: query the code graph through the wicked-garden-search skill and the read-only estate shim, one call per lookup: "$WICKED_GARDEN_ROOT/scripts/wicked-garden" run scripts/_estate_client.py --readonly call '{"tool":"SearchEntity","arguments":{"name":"<symbol>"}}' (always --readonly); then open and read every file you cite, at the lines you cite. READ-ONLY: create, edit or delete no file in any repository, commit nothing, and run no command that writes there; your output is the report.

Phase 3/3 CHECK (semantic reviewer): report the traceability matrix: each requirement id, its status, the code and the tests at file:line, and what is missing; then the code no requirement explains. PASS only when every row holds at file:line.
